info.name: Ramein BE API
info.description: Postman collection untuk API backend Ramein (Express + MYSQL + Midtrans).

item.name: POST Create First User (Initial Admin)
item.description: Hanya bisa dipakai sekali saat user masih kosong. Akun akan dibuat sebagai admin.

item.name: POST Register Admin
item.description: Sample admin mengikuti akun first user/default admin. Jika sudah ada, gunakan POST Login Admin.

item.name: DELETE Category (Admin)
item.description: Deactivate category dengan mengubah isActive menjadi false.

item.name: DELETE City (Admin)
item.description: Deactivate city dengan mengubah isActive menjadi false.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Promotor Ramein Updated",
  "description": "Organizer resmi konser",
  "contactName": "Tim Promotor",
  "contactEmail": "promotor@demo.com",
  "contactPhone": "08123456789",
  "isActive": true
}

item.name: DELETE Organizer (Admin)
item.description: Deactivate organizer dengan mengubah isActive menjadi false.

item.name: POST Create Event (User)

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Konser Akhir Tahun",
  "description": "Konser musik dengan banyak artis.",
  "categoryId": "{{category_id}}",
  "organizerId": "{{organizer_id}}",
  "cityId": "{{city_id}}",
  "addressDetail": "Gate A, lantai 1",
  "paymentType": "paid",
  "startDateTime": "2030-12-20T19:00:00.000Z",
  "endDateTime": "2030-12-20T22:00:00.000Z",
  "ticketTypes": [
    {
      "name": "Regular",
      "price": 150000,
      "quota": 100,
      "saleStartAt": "2030-11-01T00:00:00.000Z",
      "saleEndAt": "2030-12-20T18:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}

item.description: Event langsung published saat dibuat. Response berisi is_withdraw default false.

item.name: GET My Events
item.description: List event milik user login. Query opsional mengikuti GET Event List: status, organizerId, search.

item.name: GET Purchased Events by User ID
item.description: List event yang pernah dibeli user tertentu. userId wajib UUID.

item.name: GET Trending Events
item.description: List event public terbaru, limit 8.

item.name: GET Recommended Events
item.description: Rekomendasi event public berdasarkan interest/category. Default category: Konser.

item.name: GET Explore Events
item.description: Explore event public dengan filter opsional: search/q, category/kategory/categoryId, wilayah/provinsi, kota/city/cityId, date/event_date.

item.name: GET Interest Events Multi Category
item.description: Filter event public berdasarkan multi kategori. Bisa pakai categories=Music,Workshop atau category=Music&category=Workshop.

item.name: DELETE Event (Owner/Admin)
item.description: Owner event atau admin bisa menghapus event hanya jika belum ada pembelian tiket. Transaksi pending/failed/expired tanpa tiket terjual akan ikut dibersihkan.

item.name: POST Create Transaction
item.description: Quantity lebih dari 1 tetap membuat 1 transaksi. Jika transaksi paid/free, ticket dibuat sejumlah quantity. adminIncome adalah 20% dari grossAmount.

item.name: GET Event Transaction Statistic
item.description: Revenue dihitung dari transaksi paid: SUM(gross_amount - admin_income).

item.name: POST Midtrans Notification (Manual Test)
item.description: Isi `signature_key` sesuai format sha512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY).

item.name: GET My Tickets (Grouped by Transaction)
item.description: List ticket user digroup per transaction. Jika quantity 2, response utama 1 item dengan tickets berisi 2 QR.

item.name: GET Event Tickets All
item.description: List per ticket untuk kebutuhan check-in/scan.

item.name: POST Scan QR Code by Param
POST Create Withdraw
item.description: Membuat request withdraw. user_id diambil dari token login. Jika berhasil, events.is_withdraw menjadi true.

item.name: POST Update Withdraw Status (Admin)
item.description: Update status withdraw berdasarkan id di body. Status: pending, approved, rejected. Jika rejected, events.is_withdraw dikembalikan false.

item.name: GET Finance by Published By (Admin)
item.description: List finance untuk event published_by=admin. Admin only.

item.name: GET Finance by Published By User (Admin)
item.description: List finance untuk event published_by=user. Admin only.

item.name: GET Finance by Published By User and Organizer (Admin)
item.description: List finance dengan filter published_by=user dan organizer_id. Admin only.

item.name: GET Finance by Published By and Organizer (Admin)
item.description: List finance dengan filter published_by dan organizer_id. Jika organizer_id tidak dipakai, gunakan endpoint /finance/:published_by.

item.name: GET My Events
item.description: Alias endpoint untuk list event milik user login.

item.name: GET My Purchased Events
item.description: List event yang pernah dibeli user login berdasarkan transaksi paid.

item.name: GET Feedback List
item.description: Query rating opsional. Nilai rating: Sangat Puas, Puas, Cukup Puas, Tidak Puas, Sangat Tidak Puas.

item.name: POST Create Feedback
item.description: Membuat feedback. Rating wajib salah satu dari opsi yang tersedia, review opsional.

item.name: DELETE Feedback (Admin)
item.description: Admin only. Menghapus feedback berdasarkan id.
